Data:N.invisible.secrecy.json.label: An Invisible Advantage
Data:N.invisible.secrecy.json.desc: The Moth and two other unnamed Hours have challenged Calyptra in Venice… but their sleep-flowers have withered.

Data:N.lark.concluded.json.label: The Lark Abandoned
Data:N.lark.concluded.json.desc: We'll never know what Zuthi learnt or intended.

Data:N.lark.json.label: The Unfinished Lark
Data:N.lark.json.desc: What secrets enabled Zuthi Zidane's masterwork?

Data:N.lark.kept.json.label: The Lark Retained
Data:N.lark.kept.json.desc: Zuthi had been stealing secrets from the trove of Crooky, Name of the Beach-Crow. Morgen has these secrets now.

Data:N.lark.kept.serena.json.label: The Lark Secured
Data:N.lark.kept.serena.json.desc: Zuthi had been stealing secrets from the trove of Crooky, Name of the Beach-Crow. Serena - or perhaps the St Rhonwen Trust - has these secrets now.

Data:N.lark.returned.json.label: The Lark Returned
Data:N.lark.returned.json.desc: Zuthi had been stealing secrets from the trove of Crooky, Name of the Beach-Crow. These secrets might have meant war among the Hours… and so they will be returned safely to Crooky.

Data:N.lark.revealed.json.label: The Lark Revealed
Data:N.lark.revealed.json.desc: Zuthi had been stealing secrets from the trove of Crooky, Name of the Beach-Crow. These secrets have been shared with the winds - despite the risk of war among the Hours.

Data:N.mystique.concluded.json.label: The Ineffable Mystique
Data:N.mystique.concluded.json.desc: Whatever was behind the growth in religious organisations, it's no longer our business.

Data:N.mystique.helped.json.label: Yvette in Ys
Data:N.mystique.helped.json.desc: Black Elie has taken Yvette to Ys, to aid their schemes. If she was right, their schemes might include the protection of Brancrug, though not the wider continent.

Data:N.mystique.json.label: The Particular Mystique
Data:N.mystique.json.desc: There has been a curious fad for new religious organisations recently… including an odd outfit that calls itself the Ivory Dawn.

Data:N.mystique.revealed.json.label: Elie and Ys
Data:N.mystique.revealed.json.desc: Black Elie - former Obliviate, former Sisterhood Matriarch, and a Nectar-long throughout - is behind the cult called the Ivory Dawn. She intends to render Yvette Southey to Ys. She insists this will serve the so-called 'Bird' cause - the cause of stability.

Data:N.mystique.thwarted.json.label: Elie's End
Data:N.mystique.thwarted.json.desc: Black Elie's schemes are finished. Perhaps she is too. But she's always been a survivor.

Data:N.reverend.closed.json.label: The Reverend's End
Data:N.reverend.closed.json.desc: The Open Reverend has been permanently settled, and the Excellency Gnathobasis has been denied an entry-point to the Wake.

Data:N.reverend.concluded.json.label: What Reverend?
Data:N.reverend.concluded.json.desc: The Open Reverend is no business of the House. Some things are better left alone.

Data:N.reverend.json.label: The Open Reverend
Data:N.reverend.json.desc: Is the Open Reverend 'blessed' by a Knock-power identified as St Agnes? Or something else?

Data:N.reverend.success.one.json.label: The Open Reverend: Glimmering
Data:N.reverend.success.one.json.desc: The Open Reverend has not been 'blessed' by any servant of the Mother of Ants or the Horned-Axe. What then has changed him? Douglas and Ehsan are both investigating.

Data:N.reverend.success.two.json.label: The Open Reverend: Revelation
Data:N.reverend.success.two.json.desc: The Open Reverend is becoming a 'strand' of the Excellency Gnathobasis, a Name of one of the gods-from-Nowhere. The Suppression Bureau must intervene.

Data:N.revolution.ascendant.json.label: Threshold Revolution: Ascendant
Data:N.revolution.ascendant.json.desc: The Légion du Seuil has retreated from a new little Threshold in the Bounds carved out by a Zurvanist splinter-sect. The Name called the 'Fourfold Lion' has his own domain now - it's not clear whether he remains faithful to the Lionsmith.

Data:N.revolution.chandler.json.label: Threshold Revolution: For the Chandler
Data:N.revolution.chandler.json.desc: The Zurvanist splinter-sect that was causing trouble in the Bounds has abruptly abandoned its oneirosecessionist ambitions… because, it seems, of the promises made to the 'Fourfold Lion' by emissaries of the Chandler.

Data:N.revolution.crushed.json.label: Threshold Revolution: Crushed
Data:N.revolution.crushed.json.desc: The Légion du Seuil has crushed the Zurvanist splinter-sect that  was causing so much trouble. Order has been restored to the Bounds… and the Zurvanists remain faithful to the Lionsmith-Name that they follow.

Data:N.revolution.failing.json.label: Threshold Revolution: Failing
Data:N.revolution.failing.json.desc: The Légion du Seuil is restoring order to the Bounds. The rebel Zurvanist splinter-sect that follows the 'Fourfold Lion' has grown desperate.

Data:N.revolution.json.label: Threshold Revolution
Data:N.revolution.json.desc: What happened with the rebellion in the Bounds? Did our visitors help the Légion du Seuil suppress it? Or did we leave the rebels - the Zurvanist splinter-sect that follows the 'Fourfold Lion' - to grow stronger?

Data:N.revolution.lionsmith.json.label: Threshold Revolution: For the Lionsmith
Data:N.revolution.lionsmith.json.desc: The Zurvanist splinter-sect that was causing trouble in the Bounds has peacefully abandoned its oneirosecessionist ambitions… apparently because the Name called the 'Fourfold Lion' has renewed his devotion to the Lionsmith.

Data:N.revolution.surging.json.label: Threshold Revolution: Surging
Data:N.revolution.surging.json.desc: The Zurvanist splinter-sect that follows the 'Fourfold Lion' has grown stronger. It may carve out its own little Threshold in the Bounds near Meshad.

Data:N.rising.accepted.json.label: The Oracle Fulfilled
Data:N.rising.accepted.json.desc: Echidna will become Yvette's keeper. Rowena is no longer a problem for Yvette; Ys may be a problem for everyone else.

Data:N.rising.concluded.json.label: What Oracle?
Data:N.rising.concluded.json.desc: Did anyone actually benefit from following an oracle's advice? We're probably better off without.

Data:N.rising.connie.disillusioned.json.label: Whose Oracle?
Data:N.rising.connie.disillusioned.json.desc: This oracle was meant for Connie Lee - but Connie, disillusioned by the Affair of the Friar's Tapestry, has left the Bureau.

Data:N.rising.defied.json.label: The Oracle Defied
Data:N.rising.defied.json.desc: Echidna will not become Yvette's keeper. Rowena is now Yvette's problem.

Data:N.rising.heard.json.label: The Oracle of the Pale Mother
Data:N.rising.heard.json.desc: 'It is in the gift of the youngest Oculate that the Monster-Mother keeps the Jewel of Ys from the Pale Mother.' The 'Mother of Monsters' is Echidna the Ligeian, the' youngest Constable-Oculate' is Connie Lee, but what of the rest?

Data:N.rising.interpreted.json.label: The Oracle of the Pale Mother, Interpreted
Data:N.rising.interpreted.json.desc: 'It is prophesied that if Rowena meets Yvette - the Ys-Jewel - Rowena will devour her; but that if Connie brings Yvette to Echidna, Echidna would keep Yvette safe. Ys would prefer the latter. Is it better to risk Yvette's meeting her ancestor some day, or to take Yvette's freedom and risk the advancement of Ys' schemes?

Data:N.rising.json.label: The Rising While
Data:N.rising.json.desc: The Oracle of the Rising While seems to deliver true prophecies. Is it wise to heed them?

Data:N.rose.concluded.json.label: The Rose Concluded
Data:N.rose.concluded.json.desc: We'll never know themeaning of the black-and-white flower that grew in the deep desert. Perhaps that's for the best.

Data:N.rose.garden.json.label: 'Dat Rosa Mel Apibus'
Data:N.rose.garden.json.desc: The Vagabond, along with two other Hours, proposes to challenge Calyptra with a flower that is neither black nor white. She has called on an old alliance: perhaps the Carapace Cross will tend a garden of those flowers in the fallen city of Miah.

Data:N.rose.haven.json.label: 'Adaptationes Mirabiles'
Data:N.rose.haven.json.desc: The Vagabond, along with two other Hours, proposes to challenge Calyptra with a flower that is neither black nor white. She hoped the Carapace Cross would tend a garden of those flowers in the fallen city of Miah: but they prefer to dwell there in peace, without risking Calyptra's anger.

Data:N.rose.json.label: The Dappled Rose
Data:N.rose.json.desc: What was the meaning of the black-and-white flower that grew in the deep desert?

Data:N.rose.revealed.json.label: The Egg of the Dune
Data:N.rose.revealed.json.desc: The Vagabond, along with two other Hours, proposes to challenge Calyptra with a flower that is neither black nor white. To that end, she has called on an old alliance with the Carapace Cross…

Data:N.saint.buried.json.label: The Buried Saint
Data:N.saint.buried.json.desc: The miraculous wooden image in the Strasbourg church was buried in the earth.

Data:N.saint.burnt.json.label: The Burned Saint
Data:N.saint.burnt.json.desc: The miraculous wooden image in the Strasbourg church was burned in a fire.

Data:N.saint.concluded.json.label: The Forgotten Saint
Data:N.saint.concluded.json.desc: The miraculous wooden saint-image may well still retain all its miraculous properties, but we're finished with it.

Data:N.saint.dreams.accepted.json.label: A Book of Dreams
Data:N.saint.dreams.accepted.json.desc: The dreams that the wooden saint brings continue to propagate; but the dreamers now wake cheerful and refreshed.
